proposals.codex_proposal: Select a manual or automated Assessment.
proposals.author_description: Selects whether the Assessment uses a manual procedure or automated Tests.
proposals.engineering_note: The parent conditional requires procedure for manual mode and specification/tests/evaluate for automated mode. This choice does not establish execution support.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Selects whether the Assessment uses a manual procedure or automated Tests.

proposals.existing_wording: Named Tests. A capability defines its Test source shape: commonly an Object, but clean native capabilities MAY consume another first-class source such as a Variable directly.
proposals.codex_proposal: Declares named automated Tests and their acquisition and Require conditions.
proposals.author_description: Defines the named Tests available to this Assessment.
proposals.engineering_note: Describe the Test registry here; acquisition sources remain capability-dependent. Test IDs end in -test. Source selectors and Require conditions are not new semantics. Syntax does not resolve evaluate references.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Defines the named Tests available to this Assessment.

proposals.existing_wording: Allowed number of supplied values. This is independent from whether the Input must be provided: a provided empty population is distinct from an omitted binding.
proposals.codex_proposal: Declare the permitted population size of a supplied Input.
proposals.author_description: Sets how many values a supplied Input may contain.
proposals.engineering_note: Provision and value count are independent; zero values when provided are distinct from omission. Schema witnesses validate the declaration, not actual binding populations. Preserve the existing required flag as separate authority.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Sets how many values a supplied Input may contain.

proposals.existing_wording: Whether an invocation must supply this Input. False permits omission, never an invented default or empty population. Optional consumers must be dominated by an explicit input_provided conditional guard.
proposals.codex_proposal: Declare whether invocation must supply this Input.
proposals.author_description: Specifies whether this Input must be supplied.
proposals.engineering_note: False permits omission without inventing a default. Optional consumers need the accepted direct input_provided guard; this leaf does not enforce reference dominance. The witness intentionally allows required true with zero_or_more cardinality.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Specifies whether this Input must be supplied.

proposals.existing_wording: Explicit allowed values in the declared domain; no casts or defaults.
proposals.codex_proposal: Restrict supplied Input values to an explicit list.
proposals.author_description: Lists the permitted values for this Input.
proposals.engineering_note: No conversion or defaults. The declaration shape accepts mixed scalar/object entries; domain membership and datatype agreement need semantic validation. This does not promise JSON Schema enforces binding compatibility.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Lists the permitted values for this Input.

proposals.existing_wording: Use `local` for a derived value or `constant` for a literal declaration.
proposals.codex_proposal: Choose local derivation or a constant literal declaration.
proposals.author_description: Selects a constant or locally derived Variable.
proposals.engineering_note: The constant branch requires a literal expression; local may also use literals. Do not imply local must be a transform or that this keyword alone executes a function.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Distinguishes a derived Variable from a constant literal.

proposals.existing_wording: Datatype promised by this Variable. The expression must produce compatible values.
proposals.codex_proposal: Declare the datatype promised by a Variable expression.
proposals.author_description: Declares the datatype of this Variable’s values.
proposals.engineering_note: The enum is enforced, but full declaration-to-expression compatibility and casts are not established by these witnesses. Retain a semantic hold for the strength of this promise; do not imply coercion or complete tag/payload validation.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Declares the datatype of this Variable’s values.

proposals.existing_wording: A scalar, ordered list, or explicitly typed value. Use the typed form when the datatype matters; lists preserve their supplied order and duplicates.
proposals.codex_proposal: Supply literal scalar, list or typed data.
proposals.author_description: Supplies a literal value, list of values, or explicitly typed value.
proposals.engineering_note: Use this single expression-node authority for the duplicate constant-declaration literal shape; do not copy help into both. Lists preserve order and duplicates under the existing description. Casting and status semantics are not introduced.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Supplies a literal value, list of values, or explicitly typed value.

proposals.existing_wording: Read the selected field from the collected Object. Field availability, multiplicity, and collection status are semantic/runtime concerns.
proposals.codex_proposal: Read one named field from an Object collection.
proposals.author_description: Reads a field from the Items collected by an Object.
proposals.engineering_note: This operation selects one field from collected Items; missing values, multiplicity, result ordering and status propagation remain engineering questions, not claims in this sentence. Object reference resolution is separate.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Reads a field from the Items collected by an Object.

proposals.codex_proposal: Refer to a local Test outcome in evaluation.
proposals.author_description: Uses a named Test’s outcome in this expression.
proposals.engineering_note: The name pattern is checked here, but existence and scope resolution are semantic checks. This names an expression operand, not the shared acquisition reference or a stored finalized Result.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Uses a named Test’s outcome in this expression.

proposals.codex_proposal: Refer to an Assessment dependency outcome.
proposals.author_description: Uses a referenced Assessment’s outcome in this expression.
proposals.engineering_note: The string leaf does not enforce dependency declaration, resolution, version or cycle rules. Assessment.dependencies separately declares aliases. Do not promise automatic discovery or reading stored Results.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Uses a referenced Assessment’s outcome in this expression.

proposals.codex_proposal: Select a conditional branch using an outcome or Input provision guard.
proposals.author_description: Tests the condition that selects a conditional branch.
proposals.engineering_note: The condition accepts an expression or direct Input presence guard. then and else are required on the containing conditional; no default else or Boolean collapse of error/unknown is inferred.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Tests the condition that selects a conditional branch.

proposals.existing_wording: Ordered alternative branches. A conditional evaluator chooses the first true condition, evaluates only its then expression and skips later branches. Indeterminate conditions propagate rather than falling through.
proposals.codex_proposal: Ordered conditional alternatives, first true condition selects its then branch.
proposals.author_description: Selects the first true alternative branch when preceding conditions are false.
proposals.engineering_note: The existing native description explicitly defines first-true selection, skipped later branches and propagation of indeterminate conditions. This wording retains that contract without advertising fall-through for unknown/error. Else_if is the actual spelling.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Selects the first true alternative branch when preceding conditions are false.

proposals.existing_wording: Logical AND of complete Test outcomes; separate from Test Item matching.
proposals.codex_proposal: Apply logical AND to child outcomes.
proposals.author_description: Combines expression outcomes using logical AND.
proposals.engineering_note: This operates on expression outcomes, including nested expressions and Assessment references; it is separate from Item/field quantifiers. No new six-state truth table or short-circuit guarantee is proposed.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Combines expression outcomes using logical AND.

proposals.existing_wording: Logical OR of complete Test outcomes; separate from Test Item matching.
proposals.codex_proposal: Apply logical OR to child outcomes.
proposals.author_description: Combines expression outcomes using logical OR.
proposals.engineering_note: This operates on expression outcomes, including nested expressions and Assessment references; it is separate from Item/field quantifiers. No new six-state truth table or short-circuit guarantee is proposed.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Combines expression outcomes using logical OR.

proposals.codex_proposal: Apply logical ONE to child outcomes.
proposals.author_description: Requires exactly one child expression to be true.
proposals.engineering_note: The active grammar supports this operator and a nonempty recursive operand list. Confirm multi-state truth/indeterminate aggregation before clearing this proposed meaning; structural acceptance alone proves neither truth tables nor evaluation order.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Requires exactly one child expression to be true.

proposals.existing_wording: Logical XOR of complete Test outcomes; separate from Test Item matching.
proposals.codex_proposal: Apply logical XOR to child outcomes.
proposals.author_description: Combines expression outcomes using exclusive OR.
proposals.engineering_note: The active grammar supports this operator and a nonempty recursive operand list. Confirm multi-state truth/indeterminate aggregation before clearing this proposed meaning; structural acceptance alone proves neither truth tables nor evaluation order.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Combines expression outcomes using exclusive OR.

proposals.existing_wording: Author-declared, evidence-backed inability to complete a branch. Not a substitute for a failed check, a collection error, or a proven not-applicable condition.
proposals.codex_proposal: Declare an evidence-backed inability to complete a branch.
proposals.author_description: Declares that this branch cannot be evaluated and provides a reason.
proposals.engineering_note: The existing contract distinguishes this declared limitation from failed checks, collection errors and proven non-applicability. Nonblank reason is required; optional follow_up directs review. A runtime outcome is not executed by this syntax witness.

not_evaluated.reason: Source check requires unavailable remote evidence.

proposals.reviewed_author_description: Records why this branch could not be evaluated.

proposals.codex_proposal: Declare a reasoned non-applicable branch.
proposals.author_description: Declares that this branch does not apply and provides a reason.
proposals.engineering_note: The form requires a nonblank reason. Syntax does not establish the applicability predicate, truth table or adequacy of supporting evidence; do not use this form to mask unknown/error outcomes.

not_applicable.reason: A preceding platform check excludes this target.

proposals.reviewed_author_description: Records why this branch does not apply.

proposals.existing_wording: Checks population existence without comparing State predicates; corresponds to State-free OVAL check_existence.
proposals.codex_proposal: Check selected Item population existence without comparing fields.
proposals.author_description: Checks whether the required number of Items exists without comparing fields.
proposals.engineering_note: This is the distinct comparator-free Require alternative, not the comparison branch reviewed in batch 1. It forbids items_satisfying and field predicates; source OVAL attributes remain provenance, not new vocabulary.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Checks whether the required number of Items exists without comparing fields.

proposals.existing_wording: The only comparator-free field condition is confirmed absence, not an empty value or failed collection.
proposals.codex_proposal: Express confirmed absence using values_found none alone.
proposals.author_description: Requires confirmed absence of the field’s values.
proposals.engineering_note: Distinct from the generic field-predicate summary in batch 1: this is the sole comparator-free field alternative. Empty strings and error/not_collected statuses are not confirmed absence. Any comparator or values_matching alongside none is forbidden.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Requires confirmed absence of the field’s values.

proposals.existing_wording: One complete condition; distinct fields are combined with logical AND.
proposals.codex_proposal: Combine named field predicates into one complete condition.
proposals.author_description: Requires all listed field conditions to hold for an Item.
proposals.engineering_note: The existing fields description defines implicit AND of distinct fields; Item satisfaction quantification remains separate. Proposed single owner for analogous fields mappings in canonical_condition and canonical_inherited_condition; no text copying or reference rewrites are applied.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Requires all listed field conditions to hold for an Item.

proposals.existing_wording: Six-state technical Assessment/Test outcome. Informational is deliberately not a seventh technical truth value.
proposals.codex_proposal: Record the six-state Assessment or Test technical outcome.
proposals.author_description: Reports whether a Test or Assessment is true, false, errored, unknown, unevaluated, or inapplicable.
proposals.engineering_note: This shared definition owns technical outcome help for Result consumers. The constraint table retains all six exact enum spellings. No Rule pass/fail mapping or new multi-state truth table is implied.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Reports whether a Test or Assessment is true, false, errored, unknown, unevaluated, or inapplicable.

proposals.codex_proposal: Record the collection outcome separately from Boolean evaluation.
proposals.author_description: Reports the outcome of collecting an Object’s Items.
proposals.engineering_note: Show all six enum spellings in the constraint table. does_not_exist and not_collected remain separate statuses even though this sentence summarizes rather than enumerates them. Error/incomplete require nonblank diagnostics and stop_reason; incomplete requires population_complete false. No mapping to technical outcomes is inferred.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Reports the outcome of collecting an Object’s Items.

proposals.existing_wording: When true, the value has been intentionally omitted from emitted results/evidence. A redacted typed value SHALL NOT carry a value property.
proposals.codex_proposal: Indicate intentional omission of a value from results.
proposals.author_description: Indicates that the value was intentionally omitted from the reported evidence.
proposals.engineering_note: True forbids the value property; this is distinct from a collection error or missing source value. False does not require value for every datatype/status. No new redaction policy or acquisition behavior is proposed.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Indicates that the value was intentionally omitted from the reported evidence.

proposals.existing_wording: Identities of Items retained or materially referenced in this result. An evidence cap SHALL NOT require enumeration of every collected Item ID; evaluated population and truncation are reported via Assessment/Test summary and collection completeness.
proposals.codex_proposal: List retained or materially referenced Item identities.
proposals.author_description: Identifies the Items retained or referenced by this collection result.
proposals.engineering_note: The existing description explicitly permits bounded retention without enumerating the full evaluated population. This list is evidence references, not a collection count or completeness proof. Reference existence/identity checks are outside this array shape.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Identifies the Items retained or referenced by this collection result.

proposals.existing_wording: Effective application/run-controlled retained Item limit, never an evaluation threshold and never a reason to fork Benchmark/Assessment content. An operator override changes reporting volume only, subject to separately enforced resource limits and reported_elements/redaction.
proposals.codex_proposal: Describe the effective reporting limit and how it was selected.
proposals.author_description: Records the effective per-Test Item retention limit and its source.
proposals.engineering_note: This controls reporting volume, not evaluation thresholds. Null maximum_items requests no item-count cap while resource safety/redaction still apply. operator_override requires override_reason; other sources forbid override metadata. No default cap is invented.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Records the effective per-Test Item retention limit and its source.

proposals.existing_wording: Publisher-authored evidence requirements/guidance for this Assessment. This is source policy metadata, not collected runtime evidence; observed evidence belongs in Assessment Results or referenced evidence artifacts.
proposals.codex_proposal: Provide publisher-authored evidence guidance rather than observations.
proposals.author_description: Defines the publisher’s evidence requirements and guidance for this Assessment.
proposals.engineering_note: This source policy metadata is separate from observed runtime evidence in Results/artifacts. Array entry shapes remain unconstrained here; the sentence does not promise enforcement of a guidance format.
proposals.reviewed_author_description: Defines the publisher’s evidence requirements and guidance for this Assessment.
